card.intro: Give 1 to {{cap}} points at the end of a classmate’s chapter you liked. The writer sees the points and any note, never who gave them.
card.moveNote: Unspent points don’t carry over. Points given can be moved until Sunday at 23:59.

settings.title: Points from classmates and the teacher
settings.intro: Each pupil gets {{budget}} points a week to give to classmates’ chapters, at most {{cap}} to one chapter. The teacher gives points too. Totals stay with the teacher, and nobody sees a ranking.

how.title: How class points work
how.body: Everyone in the class gets {{budget}} points a week and can give up to {{cap}} to one chapter. Points are a quiet thank you: there are no totals, no lists and no ranks for pupils.

about.title: About these points
about.body: Teacher points and the note from the teacher work like marks on a school submission: only you and the teacher see them, and the moderation team if one is reported. There is no reply box; ask questions in the class threads.

pupilReport.intro: You don’t see who gave points. If a pupil’s class points look odd, report them: a moderator checks who gave them and can remove gifts. The report goes to the class log.
